tool_arguments.prompt: Create ONE square3x3 sprite sheet, EXACTLY NINE separate full-body drawings of the SAME reference bird, in row-major order. Freshly draw every pose from this exact adopted identity/style reference. It is a simple rounded background bird prop in a children's watercolor picture-book universe, NOT a human mascot or realistic wildlife painting. Moss olive green rounded kakapo, pale yellow facial disk, gray hooked bill, ochre simple markings. No flight, no takeoff, no airborne pose. Retain warm brown outline, paper-grain watercolor flat color blocks, plain brown DOT eye with no white surround, no sparkle, no human hands/arms/teeth/lips. Keep original body proportions, wing/tail count, feet anatomy and palette consistent across all9. Exactly3rows3columns, no labels/grid/captions; wide truly alpha-zero gutters separating each whole bird from every neighbor, generous transparent outside margin; place each bird around330px native height in each418px cell at uniform body scale, all feet on common corresponding support line. Keep full bill/wing/tail tips inside its own cell; do not shrink some poses or put a bird into adjacent cell. Background fully transparent, no ground, haze, shadow field, extra props or effect marks. Nine cells: (1) quiet blink, unchanged ordinary body with eye gently closed; (2) friendly greeting using ONE existing wing eased slightly out, feet stable; (3) attention/presentation to VIEWER LEFT by head/bill and existing wing oriented left, no hand; (4) attention/presentation to VIEWER RIGHT by turning head/bill right and existing wing oriented right, NOT mirror-copying the whole bird, keep identity/tail consistent; (5) thoughtful gentle head tilt and subtle up gaze, no extra arms; (6) discovery head slightly lifted and bill slightly open, no human mouth or symbols; (7) happy eyes closed with existing wings gently lifted a little, feet grounded, no extra feather shards or flight; (8) Ease only the folded wing edge a little away from the compact body; keep the body volume and both feet stable.; (9) The same broad simplified wing settles gently toward the body, without extra feather shards.. Keep all9 bodies the same scale and height except deliberately tilted head/wing, no change in belly volume or eye format. Crisp but warm drawn contours and clean intentional paper texture.
